parameters.name: DiskSet
parameters.description: Specifies whether the startup depends on the disk.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ens describe-instance-boot-configuration --instance-id i-0000 --boot-type pxe --boot-set legacy --disk-set on --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ens DescribeInstanceBootConfiguration --region cn-hangzhou --InstanceId 'i-0000' --BootSet legacy --BootType pxe --DiskSet on
